images.title: The rabbit and the nearest ten
images.purpose: Show the two neighbouring tens of 4,197, the halfway mark, and the jumps to each, so the nearest ten is the one with fewer jumps.
images.composition: One long road across the middle with a carrot at each end, the rabbit above its place on the road, and the jumps drawn as small arcs under the road.
images.exact_structure: Plain white 16:9 canvas with one horizontal road across the middle: a thick flat bar in #2B2B2B spanning most of the width, with an equal margin at the left and right. 11 evenly spaced short tick marks stand on the road for the numbers 4,190 to 4,200, so there are 10 equal gaps of one jump each. The 1st tick (left end) and the 11th tick (right end) each have a carrot standing on the road end: amber #E69F00 with a green #009E73 leaf. Number labels sit above the road: 4,190 over the left carrot, 4,200 over the right carrot, 4,195 over the 6th tick, and 4,197 over the 8th tick. The 6th tick is taller and grey #6B7280 and marks the halfway point of the road. The 8th tick is taller and #CC79A7. One flat grey rabbit, drawn in a mid hop, sits just above the 4,197 label. UNDER the road: 3 small teal #0072B2 arcs in a row join the 8th tick to the 11th tick (one arc per jump), arrowheads pointing right, with the text 3 jumps centred under them in teal. Also under the road: 7 small grey #6B7280 arcs in a row join the 8th tick back to the 1st tick, arrowheads pointing left, with the text 7 jumps centred under them in grey. The right carrot has a #CC79A7 ring around it, and the tag nearest ten sits above its 4,200 label. Nothing else is drawn.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: The nearest ten is the neighbouring ten that needs fewer jumps.
images.description: A rabbit at 4,197 between the neighbouring tens 4,190 and 4,200, with 3 jumps to one carrot and 7 jumps to the other.
images.context: Starting point is the chapter's picture of the rabbit between two carrots at neighbouring tens, with the halfway mark. The numbers are the plan's own from the concept's worked example: rabbit at 4,197, neighbours 4,190 and 4,200, halfway mark 4,195, 3 jumps and 7 jumps. The book never states a rule for a number exactly on the halfway mark, so the rabbit is deliberately not on it.
images.teaching_notes: Count the arcs aloud. The rabbit is to the right of the halfway tick, so the right carrot is nearer. Then change the rabbit to 4,192 in your head: it would go down. Misconceptions M_ROUND_UP and M_NEAR_FAR: the nearest ten can be below or above, and the number that looks most alike (4,190) is not the nearest.

image_decisions.why: The rabbit between two carrots with counted jumps is the picture that makes the nearest ten clear.
